title: Interval fields take whole numbers within caps only
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (it ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A schedule open in the editor with the service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open an existing schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the blank service form.
  5. Calendar, Distance and Engine-hours interval rows all visible.
custom_steps:
1. Enter a decimal, a negative, and a zero into an interval value.
  2. Type letters and symbols into a number field.
  3. Enter values above the caps: mileage > 999,999, engine hours > 99,999, days > 999.
  4. Set the calendar operator to "At" and try to Save with no day and/or no month.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Interval values are whole numbers, minimum 1, no decimals and no negatives; mileage caps at 999,999, engine hours at 99,999, days at 999.
  • A decimal is rejected inline and a zero is rejected inline (same rule).
  • A number field accepts digits only - letters and symbols do not enter, so there is no error to show.
  • A calendar "At" row cannot be saved without both a day and a month.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10559 (S2, Add a routine service to a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S2; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R9: “Interval values are whole numbers, minimum 1, with no decimals and no negatives. Mileage is capped at 999,999, engine hours at 99,999 and days at 999. An interval longer than 12 months is set in days”
  • S2-N2: “A decimal interval value is rejected inline”
  • S2-N5: “A number field accepts digits only. Letters and symbols do not enter the field, so there is no error to show”
  • S2-N6: “An interval of zero is rejected inline, on the same rule as a decimal and a negative”
  • S2-N7: “A calendar At row cannot be saved without a day and a month”
